title: Hamas Attack on Israel
description: Hamas launches a surprise multi-front attack from Gaza into southern Israel, killing approximately 1,200 people and taking around 250 hostages.

title: Israel Ground Offensive in Gaza
description: Israel declares war on Hamas and launches a massive aerial bombardment followed by a ground incursion into northern Gaza.

title: Temporary Ceasefire & Hostage Exchange
description: A week-long humanitarian pause allows the exchange of hostages and prisoners. Fighting resumes on December 1.

title: Houthis Begin Red Sea Attacks
description: Yemen's Houthi rebels launch sustained attacks on commercial shipping in the Red Sea in solidarity with Palestinians, disrupting global trade routes.

title: ICJ Provisional Measures Ruling
description: The International Court of Justice orders Israel to take measures to prevent genocide in Gaza following South Africa's case.

title: Israel Strikes Iranian Consulate in Damascus
description: Israel bombs Iran's consulate building in Damascus, Syria, killing senior IRGC commanders including General Mohammad Reza Zahedi.

title: Iran Retaliatory Drone & Missile Attack
description: Iran launches over 300 drones and ballistic missiles at Israel in its first-ever direct attack. Most are intercepted by Israeli, US, and allied defenses.

title: Pager & Walkie-Talkie Attacks in Lebanon
description: Covert sabotage of Hezbollah communication devices causes mass simultaneous explosions across Lebanon, killing dozens and injuring thousands.

title: Assassination of Hezbollah Leader Nasrallah
description: Israel kills Hezbollah Secretary-General Hassan Nasrallah in a massive airstrike on Beirut's southern suburbs.

title: Israel Ground Invasion of Lebanon
description: Israel launches ground operations in southern Lebanon targeting Hezbollah positions, infrastructure, and tunnel networks.

title: Israel-Hezbollah Ceasefire
description: A ceasefire agreement between Israel and Hezbollah takes effect, ending two months of ground fighting in southern Lebanon.

title: Gaza Ceasefire Agreement
description: Israel and Hamas reach a ceasefire deal. Hamas begins releasing hostages in exchange for Palestinian prisoners. The ceasefire holds for nearly two months.

title: Ceasefire Collapses — Israel Resumes Strikes
description: Israel launches surprise airstrikes on Gaza after accusing Hamas of refusing to release more hostages. Netanyahu vows to 'open the gates of hell.'

title: US Strikes on Yemen (Houthis)
description: The United States launches sustained airstrikes against Houthi targets in Yemen. April sees 279 US airstrike events — the highest monthly count since 2017. A US-Houthi ceasefire follows in May.

title: Israel-Iran 12-Day War
description: After IAEA declares Iran in violation of non-proliferation obligations, Israel launches unilateral strikes on Iranian nuclear facilities. A 12-day war erupts with strikes across 27 Iranian provinces. Iran retaliates with missiles at US bases in Qatar.

title: Israel Bombs Hamas HQ in Qatar
description: Israel strikes the Hamas political headquarters in Doha, Qatar, targeting senior leaders including Khalil al-Hayya and Khaled Mashal.

title: New Ceasefire & Hostage Deal
description: A comprehensive ceasefire takes effect under Trump's 20-point plan. Hamas releases all living Israeli hostages in exchange for 250+ Palestinian prisoners serving life sentences.

title: Operation 'Epic Fury' — US/Israel Strike Iran
description: The US and Israel launch a massive joint offensive against Iran targeting nuclear and military infrastructure. Ayatollah Khamenei is killed in the opening salvo. Iran retaliates with missiles against US bases, killing three American servicemen.
